_: Review v15: batch 7's shots, each beside its reference from docs/art/target (copied to screens/ref). docs/review/batch7.sh makes the frames (paths under its OUT folder); docs/review/v15_apply.py turns each into a screen on the review page with two versions: the target, then ours, so Side by side shows them together. 'card' is the copy sheet's card. 'needs' names the harness step that frames the shot (site, work, breach, host, camp, engine); if the step finds nothing, the shot shows the road or the square and the batch's log says so.

steps.what: Frames the n-th roadside site of a kind, from the crown's seat outward (autoplay.gd; roadside.gd sites()). play.log says where it stood, or that none of that kind stands.
Frames a trade's building in a town from the town root's works (autoplay.gd; works.gd find). play.log says where, or which trades the town has.
Frames the first open breach in a stone wall near the staged siege's front, low and oblique (the siege's front if none is open yet; autoplay.gd).
Frames the King's n-th host and clicks its standard (autoplay.gd; host_command.gd, --hosts=on). play.log says how many hosts stand.
Frames the besiegers' camp from over its tents toward the town (autoplay.gd; siege_camp.gd, --camp=on or --wall-demo).
Frames the n-th siege engine low and oblique (autoplay.gd; group siege_engines).
Holds the fields' year at a season and how far through it, and frames the n-th sown field from the crown's seat (autoplay.gd; works-life's countryside.gd hold_season).
Frames the n-th fallow field, where a shepherd's flock grazes (autoplay.gd).
Frames the town's castle low and oblique, or its gatehouse (autoplay.gd).
